tips.text: Join an established clan that already has the Silva & Aegis researched instead of building a dojo for one weapon.
Prefer a small clan: research costs scale with clan size, and big dead clans can stall for weeks.
Build a solo Ghost-tier clan if you go alone; it pays the lowest research cost.
Build only the Oracle and Tenno Lab in a solo dojo; this weapon needs no other labs.
Bank Forma before you start a dojo; every room costs 1 Forma.
Expect a day or two of resources plus the 72-hour research timer; players call the acquisition trivial.
